column3: Cinematic close-up, shallow depth of field. A person sits on a soft sofa at night in a cozy dim living room, holding a modern smartphone in both hands. The phone screen is a flat, solid, evenly lit bright chroma-key green rectangle with no content. Warm fireplace glow flickers in the background bokeh, rain streaks run down a window behind. Slow push-in, handheld subtle motion, 35mm film grain, natural skin tones. Sound: soft crackling fire, gentle rain on glass, quiet room.

Cinematic wide shot of a cozy living room at night. A large flat TV on the wall shows a perfectly flat, evenly lit, solid chroma-key green screen with nothing on it. A stone fireplace crackles beside it, rain streaks the dark windows, warm lamps glow. A person on the sofa in the foreground, seen from behind, lifts a smartphone toward the TV. Slow dolly in, shallow depth of field, 35mm film look, no text, no logos. Sound: fire crackling, soft rain, quiet room.

Overhead cinematic close-up of a smartphone resting on a chunky knitted blanket, its screen a perfectly flat solid chroma-key green with nothing on it. An adult thumb taps the screen gently. Warm lamp light, a mug of tea steams beside it, soft focus fairy lights. Slow push in, 35mm film grain, no text, no logos. Sound: soft blanket rustle, gentle tap, quiet room.

Extreme cinematic close-up of a young adult's face in a dark room at night, lit only by a cool white-blue glow from a phone held just below frame. Intense focus, eyes darting, then a sudden grin of disbelief. Reflections of light in the eyes, shallow depth of field, anamorphic look, film grain, no text. Sound: quiet room, a sharp intake of breath, then a laugh.

Cinematic close-up of two adult hands gripping a smartphone upright, thumbs pressing hard, in a dark room lit by blue and red neon reflections. The phone screen is a perfectly flat, solid chroma-key green with nothing on it. Tense, slight handheld shake, shallow depth of field, film grain, no text, no logos. Sound: low room hum, thumbs tapping glass.

Cinematic medium shot at night: three adult friends squeezed on a couch lean in around one smartphone held up in the middle, its screen a perfectly flat solid chroma-key green with nothing on it, then they erupt, cheering and laughing. TV glow and warm lamps, shallow depth of field, film grain, no text, no logos. Sound: friends cheering and laughing, couch creak.

Cinematic close-up of adult hands holding a smartphone upright in stadium bleachers at night, the phone screen a perfectly flat solid chroma-key green with nothing on it, floodlight bokeh and fog behind, breath visible in the cold air. Plain dark jacket sleeves, no logos, no team colors, no text. Sound: crowd murmur, cold wind, a whistle in the distance.

Cinematic medium shot in a dim living room at night: an adult in a plain grey hoodie stares at a phone, then leaps off the couch celebrating with both fists, TV glow on their face, popcorn flying. Slow motion feel, shallow depth of field, film grain, no text, no logos. Sound: a shout of joy, popcorn scatter, couch springs.

Cinematic wide shot at night on a quiet rooftop: a huge full moon rises over a sleeping city, stars overhead. An adult sits wrapped in a blanket holding a smartphone, its screen a perfectly flat solid chroma-key green with nothing on it, the screen faces the camera. Gentle wind moves their hair, slow push in, dreamy, film grain, no text, no logos. Sound: soft wind, distant city hush.

Cinematic close-up of an adult hand holding a smartphone over a sunlit kitchen table in the morning, the screen a perfectly flat solid chroma-key green with nothing on it, a few coins and a coffee cup on the wood, sunbeams and dust in the air. Slow push in, shallow depth of field, film grain, no text, no logos. Sound: morning birds, a spoon against a cup.

Macro slow-motion shot of shiny gold coins dropping one by one into a glass jar, warm golden light, dust motes, shallow depth of field, coins clinking and spinning, film grain, no text, no logos. Sound: crisp coin clinks against glass, soft ring.
